name: android-build-guard
description: Enforces isolated copy-on-write Android builds in My Flow worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Keeps Android builds isolated and reproducible.
interface.longDescription: Android Build Guard directs agents through the named My Flow copy-on-write build wrappers and blocks direct AOSP, kernel, Docker, and Podman build paths that could contaminate shared source volumes.
defaultPrompt: Build this Android device with the isolated COW workflow.
Prepare the pinned Android 4.4.4 base safely.
